title: frametrail:attributes of type "webpage"
description: Web page shown in an iframe, or as a card when the site forbids embedding. The src is the page's URL. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "webpage". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

embed.description: Whether the site allows being embedded in an iframe, as detected when the resource was added.

description.description: Description shown on the card. HTML.
